name: Ōmura (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ōmura city emblem in white: an outlined ring of segments enclosing the character 大.
history: Municipal flag of Ōmura, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1948.

features.role: Ōmura city emblem — an outlined ring of segments enclosing the character 大
